notes: HTML stored exactly as returned by FetchResult.html (httpx text), UTF-8 encoded. The page is static Drupal HTML (no JavaScript needed). It holds four 'recruitment_vacancy' view blocks (Recruitment Rules/Notification, CPSE Vacancies, MoS Vacancies, Young Professional/ Consultant/Trainee etc.), each a table S. No. | Title | Documents | Validity Date. The CPSE and MoS blocks share one pager (?page=1 is their second page). The registry URL https://steel.gov.in/vacancies returned HTTP 404 on the capture date. 'sha256' is the exact captured bytes; 'sha256_lf' is the same content with CRLF read as LF (vacancy_page_1.html had four CRLFs inside Drupal BigPipe scripts), which survives git line-ending conversion.
